args.title: Return line
args.goal: renderReceipt appends the exact line "Returns within 14 days with receipt." after the total line.
args.scope: In src/receipt.mjs, keep the item line and the Total: line, then append that return line. Leave src/receipt.test.mjs able to pass the existing test named "includes the total". Do not add a barcode and do not rename the total label.
args.acceptance: renderReceipt returns the item line, then a line that still begins with Total:, then the exact line Returns within 14 days with receipt. The test named "includes the total" still passes. From the delivery repo, node --test src/receipt.test.mjs passes.

args.title: Barcode
args.goal: After the return line is in the receipt, renderReceipt appends a barcode line.
args.scope: Change only src/receipt.mjs, the same file as the return line. There is no barcode file in the repo; do not add one. This work merges only after T2.
args.acceptance: renderReceipt appends a barcode line after the return line. The change is only in src/receipt.mjs. The ticket is merged only after T2.

args.title: Total label
args.goal: The total line label changes from Total: to Amount due:.
args.scope: In src/receipt.mjs, rename the total line label from Total: to Amount due:. In src/receipt.test.mjs, the test named "includes the total" currently expects Total: and must expect Amount due: instead. This ticket does not wait on the return line or the barcode.
args.acceptance: renderReceipt prints Amount due: where it printed Total:. The test named "includes the total" expects Amount due:. The ticket has no merge dependency on T2 or T4. From the delivery repo, node --test src/receipt.test.mjs passes.
